title: Prove the proxy-conversion save commits before checking retired overview preservation
outcome: The overview-retirement regression positively proves the proxy metadata save reached SQLite, so a skipped or isolated write cannot produce a false pass.
acceptance: The proxy-conversion step in message_saves_leave_retired_overview_storage_inert asserts that the committed SQLite session row contains the expected remote identity or proxy preview before checking that historical overview values are preserved; a skipped proxy save cannot satisfy the assertion.
